Name: Kenneth's Axe Forge
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Axe Forge[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]9 axes for Kenneth's Weapon Shop. Forge, anvil, and smith looks.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you get[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]9 axes in Kenneth's Weapon Shop - Shop6, all with that solid, worn-in feel. Some are light and fast, some are steady for everyday use, and some are heavy and hit hard. Forge axes, smith axes, kiln axes, and anvil axes are in there.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Check Kenneth's Weapon Shop - Shop6 in game when you have time, and see which one fits how you play.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Where to buy[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Kenneth's Weapon Shop - Shop6[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Each axe is sold once a day. You buy it with gold plus bars / gems / materials, so bring both when you stop by.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How to play[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Go to Kenneth's Weapon Shop, Shop6.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Take a look at what is for sale.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Buy the one you like. Shop only, no quests, no crafting.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you need[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Stardew Valley 1.6[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• SMAPI[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Kenneth's Weapon Shop - you need this so Shop6 shows up[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• DSS[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How to install[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher first.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2. Put this mod in your Mods folder.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]3. Make sure Kenneth's Weapon Shop is also installed.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]4. Start the game and check Shop6.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Works with other mods?[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Yeah. Works with the other weapons from Kenneth's Weapon Shop. You can add it in the middle of a save, no need to start a new game.[/b][/size]
